causal_pass_criteria.C1_INITIAL_BASELINE: Zero pre-existing STDP weight bias at initial state (||W|| = 0.0 at tick 0)
causal_pass_criteria.C2_GEOMETRIC_VALIDITY: Route choice defined by physical corridor boundary occupancy (y > +0.25m or y < -0.25m)
causal_pass_criteria.C3_HAZARD_EVENT: Tested hazard encounter timestamped with physical collision/stall telemetry
causal_pass_criteria.C4_LEARNING_ATTRIBUTION: Attributable STDP updates distinguished from startup/wheel slip transients
causal_pass_criteria.C5_TEMPORAL_PRECEDENCE: Hazard encounter precedes attributable learning, which precedes policy difference
causal_pass_criteria.C6_PHYSICAL_POLICY_EFFECT: Learned state causes physically distinguishable trajectory divergence
causal_pass_criteria.C7_COUNTERFACTUAL_CONTROL: NO_STDP fails to reproduce adaptive route switch under matched initial state
causal_pass_criteria.C9_ABLATION: Zeroing W in STDP_ABLATION abolishes the learned detour behaviour
